cases: a Spring Boot app with pom.xml, no package.json, and no JS/TS app source starts with Maven on 8080, not npm
a Go app with go.mod or main.go, no package.json, and no JS/TS app source starts with go run on 8080, not npm
a package.json still wins the Node install, start, and main's port even when a pom.xml is also present
Spring Boot or Go with package.json uses npm and probes 5173, which is main's oneShotDevPort, not the registry 8080
the npm plan matches main's install command, start command, and oneShotDevPort for every registered framework
a Spring Boot label without a POM does not invent a Maven start and keeps main's Node path on 5173
a Vite tree with src/App.tsx, index.html, and no package.json keeps main's npm path and typecheck
Java static JS under src/main/resources is not JS/TS app source, so a Spring starter stays on Maven
a bare HTML page with no package.json keeps main's Node install in the fast lane; platform preview still skips (Q-2662)
a Node tree with package.json still attempts the platform preview; a Vite tree with app source and no package.json does not
independently written English and Hindi battle-royale map-game file lists that hold only a Spring Boot starter stay on Maven
Flask's one-shot port stays 8000, and oneShotDevPort for Spring Boot and Go matches main at 5173
a unique temporary directory with no package.json does not echo STALE from the deps check; a Node tree still does
mvn spring-boot:run and go run main.go are long-running dev servers; mvn package and go test are not

the missing-manifest shipping exclusion checks the tree: it fires only for a clearly non-Node tree with no package.json; error text alone, a nested frontend/package.json, a Vite tree with src/App.tsx, and a call with no tree evidence stay failures
a JS app missing package.json is a SANDBOX_CMD_FAILED shipping error, the release gate is RED, ok is flipped, and zeroBillForFailedBuild is ₹0, matching main
a real ERESOLVE still ships as a failure
a missing Maven or Go binary is not a shipping error; a Maven compile error from a present toolchain still is
fastVerifyOnce skips sandbox tsc only when the plan is framework; the Node path still reconciles before tsc

an unterminated PNG tail is dropped, finished text files are kept, the continuation prompt does not name the PNG, and a truncated TypeScript file still continues; a truncated binary-only reply still throws
reversion of the npm-plan port, the missing-manifest Node fallback, and the tree-aware shipping exclusion each fail the matching tests; all three sources were restored from unique mktemp backups
limitations: not a replay of a customer build
starting Maven or Go depends on those binaries being present on the sandbox image; a missing binary stays infrastructure and unproven, at real cost without markup, and is not counted as an app defect
the framework pick is not auto-switched away from Spring Boot
oneShotDevPort is unchanged from main; a Maven or Go start gets 8080 from the launch plan, not from oneShotDevPort
a bare HTML page with no package.json is still not statically served or browser-proved (Q-2662)
other preview-revive paths that still hard-code npm run dev were left unchanged; only the platform-preview start path uses the launch plan
